public_holidays: 2026-09-24 (Thursday): departmental holiday for the 88th anniversary of Pando. Departmental Decree 05/2026 suspended public and private activities across the department for this date.
culture-cycles.note: Decreto Departamental 05/2026, signed 21 September 2026, article 1, read directly as a scanned two-page PDF. This is the 2026 declaration only. No 2027 holiday or annual recurrence has been checked. Other departmental holidays not yet checked.
